role: Regional planning organization providing socio-economic and land use projections
stance_basis: described as a participating regional planning organization providing data and oversight, with no expressed position for or against the project
summary: SCAG is described throughout this document window as a key regional planning and coordinating organization that participated in the September 1976 decision to pursue the Regional Transportation Development Program, serves on both the Interagency Coordinating Committee and Interagency Technical Committee, and is responsible for general regional transportation planning and administration of Federal grant monies in the Los Angeles region. SCAG also provided the regional population projections (SCAG-76 Growth Forecast Policy) used in the alternatives analysis. The document portrays SCAG as an institutional partner and data source rather than as an entity expressing a stance for or against any particular alternative.
complaint_summary: SCAG is identified as one of the September 1976 representatives who decided that SCRTD should submit an application to UMTA for financing to proceed with the four-point Regional Transportation Development Program.
summary_quote: In September, 1976 representatives of the City of Los Angeles, CalTrans, Southern California Association of Governments; the County of Los Angeles and the Southern California Rapid Transit District, decided that the District should submit an application to the Urban Mass Transportation Administration (UMTA) for financing to proceed with a four-point Regional Transportation Development Program
